nudge.text: New here? I can walk you through setup.

toggle.label: Show the guide assistant
toggle.description: Floating help button with step-by-step product tours.

overlay.missing: This element isn't visible right now.

encryptionPassword.title: Set up your encryption password
encryptionPassword.description: Protect your backups with a password only you know.

new.title: Choose a password
new.body: Type a strong encryption password here. It protects every backup you create.

confirm.title: Confirm it
confirm.body: Type the same password again so a typo can't lock you out.

escrow.title: Optional recovery escrow
escrow.body: Enable this so recovery codes can restore access if you ever forget the password.

save.title: Save
save.body: Save to apply your new encryption password.

configureStorage.title: Connect your storage host
configureStorage.description: Point Dockstash at the SSH host where backups are stored.

host.title: Host address
host.body: Enter the hostname or IP address of your storage server.

key.title: SSH private key
key.body: Paste the private key used to connect. It is encrypted at rest.

save.title: Save and test
save.body: Save the connection, then test it to verify access.

retentionPolicy.title: Tune your retention policy
retentionPolicy.description: Decide how many daily, weekly and monthly snapshots to keep.

daily.title: Daily snapshots
daily.body: Set how many daily snapshots are kept before rotation.

save.title: Save
save.body: Apply the retention policy to future backup runs.

exploreFleet.title: Explore your fleet
exploreFleet.description: See every registered agent and its connection status in one place.

overview.title: Fleet overview
overview.body: This page lists every agent you've registered — the VPS machines Dockstash backs up — along with their connection status.

register.title: Register an agent
register.body: Click here to add a new agent. An agent is a VPS you want Dockstash to back up.

name.title: Name it
name.body: Give the agent a name you'll recognize later, like "web-1" or "db-prod".

host.title: Host address
host.body: Enter the hostname or IP address of that VPS.

port.title: Port
port.body: Leave this blank to use the default SSH port, 22, or enter a custom one.

submit.title: Finish registering
submit.body: Register the agent to generate its API key. The key is shown once, so copy it before closing the dialog.

install.title: Install the agent
install.body: Copy this command and run it on the VPS. It starts the Dockstash agent with the token baked in.

online.title: Watch it come online
online.body: Once the agent is running it phones home every few seconds. Its status here flips to Online within a minute.

exploreSnapshots.title: Browse snapshots
exploreSnapshots.description: Find and restore backup snapshots per project.

overview.title: Snapshots
overview.body: Pick a project to browse its snapshots and restore points.
